comment: Ranked model candidates per role. Picked by tools/select_model.py, which probes availability on the configured provider and chooses the first candidate that responds. When selected_at is older than review_after_days, the selection is STALE: re-research the current model landscape (price + quality) before building, update the ranking and selected_at.
rationale: As of Oct 2026 the Claude cheap tier (Haiku 4.5) is the best price/quality for bulk wiki writing when available; Sonnet 5 is the balanced flagship used when Haiku is not enabled on the provider (e.g. Vertex project ailab-etg only exposes claude-sonnet-5). Opus is a last resort on cost. Revisit as new Haiku/Sonnet generations ship.

candidates.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
candidates.why: cheap tier, good enough for page writing when the brief lists required pages

candidates.name: Claude Sonnet 5
candidates.why: balanced flagship; stronger planning/tool-use; use for quality builds

candidates.name: Claude Opus 4.8
candidates.why: highest quality, highest cost; only if cheaper tiers unavailable

candidates.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
candidates.why: memory updates run often; cheapest capable tier

candidates.name: Claude Sonnet 5
candidates.why: fallback when Haiku is not enabled on the provider

candidates.name: Claude Sonnet 5
candidates.why: fallback when Haiku unavailable on provider

build_history.provider: gemini-enterprise (Vertex AI, project ailab-etg, location global)
build_history.note: Sonnet used because it was the only Claude model enabled on the Vertex project; Haiku 4.5 returned 404 and the Anthropic API keys were credit-blocked.
